caption:
Estonia ❤️ Finland: Tallinn’s Rotermann quarter, Turku’s Aura River dawn, and Tampere’s Finlayson brickwork frame three close four-woman reunions in sharply short RAZE couture, colorful knee-highs, and sculptural statement boots.

#WorldXXXSeries #RAZE
altTexts: Four fictional adult women in short copper-black, lilac, red-blue-white, and emerald RAZE looks stand in heels in Tallinn's Rotermann Quarter as the woman at left kisses the blonde woman's cheek.

Four fictional adult women in black-bronze, blue-amber, magenta-silver, and teal RAZE looks wear distinct sculptural knee-high boots on Turku's Aura River promenade while the woman at right kisses her neighbor's cheek.
Four fictional adult women in short copper, pearl, turquoise-ivory, and plum-green RAZE looks wear colorful knee-high boots in Tampere's Finlayson courtyard as the two women at left share a kiss.
